{{Quote|Flames! The village is attacked! This... this has happened before... I remember... the village is... dead...|Denkra Kymeri|<ref name="AED" />}}
The '''Howling Crag Clan Village''' was a [[City/Legends|village]] located in the [[Susk'kinad]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The village was inhabited by the [[Howling Crag Clan]], including a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] by the name of [[Denkra Kymeri]]. Denkra, the middle daughter of [[Amaya Kymeri]], assumed the role of protecting the village. However, sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], an outbreak of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] decimated the villagers, including Denkra. In an attempt to contain the outbreak, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the clan. However, Kymeri, along with two of [[Gender/Legends|her]] sisters, [[Naija Kymeri]] and [[Thestriel Kymeri]], formed the [[Sisters of the Void]], used spells to fight off the contagion, and took on new names, Denkra's being "Voidsister Warrior". In her [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] state, Denkra remained at the village, still believing she had a responsibility to protect it and her other undead clan mates. Eventually, the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of Amaya Kymeri sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to destroy the village and Denkra once and for all.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Howling Crag Clan Village was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
